text: backaldrin International The Kornspitz Company GmbH, the Austrian baking company behind the Original Kornspitz brand, is a family-owned business: its team page says its history is 'still closely linked to the founding and owner family, the Augendoplers', and names the owning family as Peter Augendopler sen. with Peter Augendopler jun. and Regina Augendopler.
short: backaldrin is owned by its founding family, the Augendoplers.

source.name: backaldrin (company site): Our Team
source.quote: The history of backaldrin is still closely linked to the founding and owner family, the Augendoplers. This international family-owned business
source.note: Same page: 'The Owning Family Peter Augendopler sen. with Peter Augendopler jun. and Regina Augendopler.' The company history page (https://www.backaldrin.com/en/company/history) says 'The history of backaldrin is closely linked to its owners and founders, the Augendopler family.' and dates the company to 1964, the Kornspitz brand to 1984.
